12	class TodoController extends Controller
13	{
14	    public function index(Request $request)
15	    {
16	        $todos = $request->user()->todos()->get();
17	        $today = now()->startOfDay();
18	
19	        $completedTodayIds = TodoCompletion::whereIn('todo_id', $todos->pluck('id'))
20	            ->whereDate('completed_on', $today->toDateString())
21	            ->pluck('todo_id');
22	
23	        $todos->each(function (Todo $todo) use ($today, $completedTodayIds) {
24	            $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn($today);
25	            $todo->completed_today = $completedTodayIds->contains($todo->id);
26	        });
27	
28	        return TodoResource::collection($todos);
29	    }
30	
31	    public function store(Request $request)
32	    {
33	        $validated = $this->validated($request);
34	
35	        $nextPosition = (int) ($request->user()->todos()->max('position') ?? -1) + 1;
36	
37	        $todo = $request->user()->todos()->create([
38	            ...$validated,
39	            'position' => $nextPosition,
40	        ]);
41	
42	        $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn(now()->startOfDay());
43	        $todo->completed_today = false;
44	
45	        return new TodoResource($todo);
46	    }
47	
48	    public function update(Request $request, Todo $todo)
49	    {
50	        $this->authorize('update', $todo);
51	
52	        $validated = $this->validated($request);
53	        $todo->update($validated);
54	
55	        $today = now()->startOfDay();
56	        $todo->due_today = $todo->isDueOn($today);
57	        $todo->completed_today = $todo->completions()
58	            ->whereDate('completed_on', $today->toDateString())
59	            ->exists();
60	
61	        return new TodoResource($todo);
62	    }
63	
64	    public function destroy(Request $request, Todo $todo)
65	    {
66	        $this->authorize('delete', $todo);
67	
68	        $todo->delete();
69	
70	        return response()->noContent();
71	    }
72	
73	    public function reorder(Request $request)
74	    {
75	        $user = $request->user();
76	
77	        $validated = $request->validate([
78	            'todo_ids' => ['required', 'array'],
79	            'todo_ids.*' => ['integer'],
80	        ]);
81	
82	        $ownedIds = $user->todos()->pluck('id');
83	
84	        foreach (array_values($validated['todo_ids']) as $position => $todoId) {
85	            if (! $ownedIds->contains($todoId)) {
86	                continue;
87	            }
88	
89	            DB::table('todos')
90	                ->where('id', $todoId)
91	                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
92	                ->update(['position' => $position]);
93	        }
94	
95	        return $this->index($request);
96	    }

98	    public function toggle(Request $request, Todo $todo)

103

5	use Carbon\CarbonInterface;

7	use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
8	use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
9	use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
10	use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
11	
12	#[Fillable(['title', 'description', 'recurrence', 'interval_days', 'start_date', 'position'])]
13	class Todo extends Model
14	{
15	    /** @use HasFactory<\Database\Factories\TodoFactory> */
16	    use HasFactory;
17	
18	    protected function casts(): array
19	    {
20	        return [
21	            'start_date' => 'date',
22	            'interval_days' => 'integer',
23	        ];
24	    }
25	
26	    public function user(): BelongsTo
27	    {
28	        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
29	    }
30	
31	    public function completions(): HasMany
32	    {
33	        return $this->hasMany(TodoCompletion::class);
34	    }
35	
36	    /**
37	     * Whether this todo has an occurrence falling on the given date.
38	     */
39	    public function isDueOn(CarbonInterface $date): bool
40	    {
41	        $date = $date->copy()->startOfDay();
42	        $start = $this->start_date->copy()->startOfDay();
43	
44	        if ($date->lt($start)) {
45	            return false;
46	        }
47	
48	        return match ($this->recurrence) {
49	            'once' => $date->equalTo($start),
50	            'daily' => true,
51	            'weekly' => $start->diffInDays($date) % 7 === 0,
52	            'custom' => $start->diffInDays($date) % max(1, (int) $this->interval_days) === 0,
53	            default => false,
54	        };
55	    }
56	}

    public function boot(): void
    {
        // This app has no server-rendered login page to redirect guests to
        // (Next.js owns the UI) — always fall through to the standard
        // AuthenticationException, which renders as JSON 401 for api/* per
        // bootstrap/app.php's shouldRenderJsonWhen. Without this, an

        // redirect-to-named-route('login') behavior, which throws

        // of cleanly 401ing.

1	const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000";
2	
3	export class ApiError extends Error {
4	  status: number;
5	  data: unknown;
6	
7	  constructor(status: number, data: unknown) {
8	    super(`API error ${status}`);
9	    this.status = status;
10	    this.data = data;
11	  }
12	}
13	
14	function readCookie(name: string): string | undefined {
15	  if (typeof document === "undefined") return undefined;
16	  const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )${name}=([^;]*)`));
17	  return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : undefined;
18	}
19	
20	async function ensureCsrfCookie(): Promise<void> {
21	  await fetch(`${API_URL}/sanctum/csrf-cookie`, { credentials: "include" });
22	}
23	
24	type ApiFetchOptions = Omit<RequestInit, "body"> & { body?: unknown };
25	
26	export async function apiFetch<T>(
27	  path: string,
28	  options: ApiFetchOptions = {},
29	): Promise<T> {
30	  const method = (options.method ?? "GET").toUpperCase();
31	
32	  if (method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD") {
33	    await ensureCsrfCookie();
34	  }
35	
36	  const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
37	  headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
38	  if (options.body !== undefined) {
39	    headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
40	  }
41	  const xsrfToken = readCookie("XSRF-TOKEN");
42	  if (xsrfToken) {
43	    headers.set("X-XSRF-TOKEN", xsrfToken);
44	  }
45	
46	  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
47	    ...options,
48	    method,
49	    headers,
50	    credentials: "include",
51	    body: options.body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined,
52	  });
53	
54	  if (!res.ok) {
55	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
56	    throw new ApiError(res.status, data);
57	  }
58	
59	  if (res.status === 204) {
60	    return undefined as T;
61	  }
62	
63	  return (await res.json()) as T;
64	}
65

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Resources\GigLeadResource;
use App\Models\GigLead;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class GigLeadController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $leads = $request->user()->gigLeads()->latest()->get();

        return GigLeadResource::collection($leads);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'url' => [
                'required',
                'url:http,https',
                'max:2048',
                Rule::unique('gig_leads')->where('user_id', $request->user()->id),
            ],
            'country' => ['required', Rule::in(['usa', 'canada'])],
            'job_type' => ['required', Rule::in([
                'full_time',
                'part_time',
                'short_term_contract',
                'long_term_contract',
            ])],
            'origin' => ['required', Rule::in(['linkedin', 'arc', 'indeed', 'gunio', 'other'])],
        ]);

        $lead = $request->user()->gigLeads()->create($validated);

        return new GigLeadResource($lead);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, GigLead $gigLead)
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $gigLead);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'status' => ['required', Rule::in(['new', 'reviewed', 'dismissed'])],
        ]);

        $gigLead->update($validated);

        return new GigLeadResource($gigLead);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, GigLead $gigLead)
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $gigLead);

        $gigLead->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}

```

import { apiFetch } from "./api";
import type { GigLead, GigLeadInput, GigLeadStatus } from "./gig-lead-types";

export async function getGigLeads(): Promise<GigLead[]> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: GigLead[] }>("/api/gig-leads");
  return res.data;
}

export async function createGigLead(input: GigLeadInput): Promise<GigLead> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: GigLead }>("/api/gig-leads", {
    method: "POST",
    body: input,
  });
  return res.data;
}

export async function updateGigLeadStatus(
  id: number,
  status: GigLeadStatus,
): Promise<GigLead> {
  const res = await apiFetch<{ data: GigLead }>(`/api/gig-leads/${id}`, {
    method: "PATCH",
    body: { status },
  });
  return res.data;
}

export function deleteGigLead(id: number): Promise<void> {
  return apiFetch<void>(`/api/gig-leads/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

"use client";

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import type {
  GigLeadCountry,
  GigLeadInput,
  GigLeadJobType,
  GigLeadOrigin,
} from "@/lib/gig-lead-types";

function isValidUrl(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === "http:" || url.protocol === "https:";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function GigLeadForm({
  onSubmit,
}: {
  onSubmit: (input: GigLeadInput) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [country, setCountry] = useState<GigLeadCountry>("usa");
  const [jobType, setJobType] = useState<GigLeadJobType>("full_time");
  const [origin, setOrigin] = useState<GigLeadOrigin>("linkedin");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    if (!isValidUrl(url)) {
      setError("Enter a valid http(s) URL.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onSubmit({ url, country, job_type: jobType, origin });
      setUrl("");
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError) {
        const message =
          typeof err.data === "object" && err.data && "message" in err.data
            ? String((err.data as { message: unknown }).message)
            : "Couldn't save that lead.";
        setError(message);
      } else {
        setError("Couldn't save that lead.");
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded border border-black/10 p-4 dark:border-white/10"
    >
      <input
        type="url"
        placeholder="https://..."
        required
        value={url}
        onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
        className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 text-sm dark:border-white/10"
      />

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-sm">
        <label className="flex items-center gap-1">
          Country
          <select
            value={country}
            onChange={(e) => setCountry(e.target.value as GigLeadCountry)}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 dark:border-white/10"
          >
            <option value="usa">USA</option>
            <option value="canada">Canada</option>
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="flex items-center gap-1">
          Job type
          <select
            value={jobType}
            onChange={(e) => setJobType(e.target.value as GigLeadJobType)}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 dark:border-white/10"
          >
            <option value="full_time">Full time</option>
            <option value="part_time">Part time</option>
            <option value="short_term_contract">Short term contract</option>
            <option value="long_term_contract">Long term contract</option>
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="flex items-center gap-1">
          Origin
          <select
            value={origin}
            onChange={(e) => setOrigin(e.target.value as GigLeadOrigin)}
            className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 dark:border-white/10"
          >
            <option value="linkedin">LinkedIn</option>
            <option value="arc">Arc</option>
            <option value="indeed">Indeed</option>
            <option value="gunio">Gun.io</option>
            <option value="other">Other</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>

      {error && <p className="text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}

      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={submitting}
        className="self-start rounded bg-foreground px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium text-background disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        Add lead
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}

```

"use client";

import type {
  GigLead,
  GigLeadJobType,
  GigLeadOrigin,
  GigLeadStatus,
} from "@/lib/gig-lead-types";

const JOB_TYPE_LABELS: Record<GigLeadJobType, string> = {
  full_time: "Full time",
  part_time: "Part time",
  short_term_contract: "Short term contract",
  long_term_contract: "Long term contract",
};

const ORIGIN_LABELS: Record<GigLeadOrigin, string> = {
  linkedin: "LinkedIn",
  arc: "Arc",
  indeed: "Indeed",
  gunio: "Gun.io",
  other: "Other",
};

export function GigLeadItem({
  lead,
  onSetStatus,
  onDelete,
}: {
  lead: GigLead;
  onSetStatus: (id: number, status: GigLeadStatus) => void;
  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
}) {
  const addedAt = new Date(lead.added_at).toLocaleString();

  return (
    <li
      className={`flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded border border-black/10 p-3 text-sm dark:border-white/10 ${
        lead.status === "dismissed" ? "opacity-50" : ""
      }`}
    >
      <div>
        <a
          href={lead.url}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noreferrer noopener"
          className="font-medium hover:underline"
        >
          {lead.url}
        </a>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
          {lead.country === "usa" ? "USA" : "Canada"} ·{" "}
          {JOB_TYPE_LABELS[lead.job_type]} · {ORIGIN_LABELS[lead.origin]}
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Added {addedAt}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
        {lead.status !== "reviewed" && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onSetStatus(lead.id, "reviewed")}
            className="hover:text-foreground"
          >
            Mark reviewed
          </button>
        )}
        {lead.status !== "dismissed" && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onSetStatus(lead.id, "dismissed")}
            className="hover:text-foreground"
          >
            Dismiss
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onDelete(lead.id)}
          className="hover:text-red-600"
        >
          Delete
        </button>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  createGigLead,
  deleteGigLead,
  getGigLeads,
  updateGigLeadStatus,
} from "@/lib/gig-leads";
import type { GigLead, GigLeadInput, GigLeadStatus } from "@/lib/gig-lead-types";
import { GigLeadForm } from "./gig-lead-form";
import { GigLeadItem } from "./gig-lead-item";

export function GigLeadList() {
  const [leads, setLeads] = useState<GigLead[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [requestId, setRequestId] = useState(0);
  const [resolvedId, setResolvedId] = useState(-1);
  const loading = requestId !== resolvedId;

  useEffect(() => {
    let ignore = false;

    getGigLeads()
      .then((data) => {
        if (ignore) return;
        setLeads(data);
        setError(null);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!ignore) setError("Couldn't load your gig leads.");
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!ignore) setResolvedId(requestId);
      });

    return () => {
      ignore = true;
    };
  }, [requestId]);

  function reload() {
    setRequestId((n) => n + 1);
  }

  async function handleCreate(input: GigLeadInput) {
    await createGigLead(input);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleSetStatus(id: number, status: GigLeadStatus) {
    await updateGigLeadStatus(id, status);
    reload();
  }

  async function handleDelete(id: number) {
    await deleteGigLead(id);
    reload();
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="mb-4 text-xl font-semibold">Gig Leads</h1>

      <div className="mb-4">
        <GigLeadForm onSubmit={handleCreate} />
      </div>

      {error && <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}

      {loading && leads.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading...</p>
      ) : leads.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">No leads yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {leads.map((lead) => (
            <GigLeadItem
              key={lead.id}
              lead={lead}
              onSetStatus={handleSetStatus}
              onDelete={handleDelete}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```

Everything's wired up and deployed. Summary of what I built:

**Backend** (`api/`):
- Migration `create_gig_leads_table`: `url`, `country` (usa/canada), `job_type` (full_time/part_time/short_term_contract/long_term_contract), `origin` (linkedin/arc/indeed/gunio/other), `status` (new/reviewed/dismissed), timestamps — scoped per `user_id`
- `GigLead` model, `GigLeadPolicy` (owner-only update/delete), `GigLeadResource`
- `GigLeadController`: `index`/`store`/`update` (status only)/`destroy`, server-side URL validation (`url:http,https`), and dedupe via a per-user unique check on `url`
- Routes under `auth:sanctum` at `/api/gig-leads`
- Ran the migration on the live DB (production == dev on this box)

**Frontend** (`web/`):
- `gig-lead-types.ts`, `gig-leads.ts` API client
- `GigLeadForm` (URL input with client-side `new URL()` validation + http/https check, plus dropdowns for country/job type/origin), `GigLeadItem` (mark reviewed/dismissed, delete), `GigLeadList`
- Wired into the existing `/gig-leads` page behind `RequireAuth`

I also added a `status` field (new/reviewed/dismissed) since CLAUDE.md's Gig Leads spec explicitly calls for marking leads reviewed/dismissed — without it the list would just grow forever.

Caught and fixed one bug along the way: the API was returning `status: null` instead of `"new"` right after creating a lead (Eloquent doesn't reflect DB column defaults back onto the in-memory model after `create()`), fixed by setting it explicitly in the controller. Verified via `php artisan tinker` and a clean `npm run build` + TypeScript check; rebuilt and restarted `myeverything-web`. Browser-based click-through is worth doing next since my curl-based smoke test hit an unrelated pre-existing session/cookie quirk (same 401 on the already-working `/api/todos` endpoint with the same cookie jar) that's a testing artifact, not a regression.

1	<?php
2	
3	namespace App\Support;
4	
5	class HostSafety
6	{
7	    /**
8	     * Reject URLs that don't point at a public HTTP(S) host, to guard
9	     * against SSRF via user-supplied feed URLs (internal services, cloud
10	     * metadata endpoints, loopback, etc).
11	     */
12	    public static function isSafeFeedUrl(string $url): bool
13	    {
14	        $parts = parse_url($url);
15	
16	        if (! $parts || empty($parts['host'])) {
17	            return false;
18	        }
19	
20	        if (! in_array($parts['scheme'] ?? '', ['http', 'https'], true)) {
21	            return false;
22	        }
23	
24	        $host = $parts['host'];
25	        $ips = filter_var($host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP) ? [$host] : self::resolve($host);
26	
27	        if ($ips === []) {
28	            return false;
29	        }
30	
31	        foreach ($ips as $ip) {
32	            if (! self::isPublicIp($ip)) {
33	                return false;
34	            }
35	        }
36	
37	        return true;
38	    }
39	
40	    /**
41	     * @return array<int, string>
42	     */
43	    private static function resolve(string $host): array
44	    {
45	        $records = @dns_get_record($host, DNS_A + DNS_AAAA);
46	
47	        if ($records === false) {
48	            return [];
49	        }
50	
51	        $ips = [];
52	        foreach ($records as $record) {
53	            if (isset($record['ip'])) {
54	                $ips[] = $record['ip'];
55	            } elseif (isset($record['ipv6'])) {
56	                $ips[] = $record['ipv6'];
57	            }
58	        }
59	
60	        return $ips;
61	    }
62	
63	    private static function isPublicIp(string $ip): bool
64	    {
65	        return filter_var(
66	            $ip,
67	            FILTER_VALIDATE_IP,
68	            FILTER_FLAG_NO_PRIV_RANGE | FILTER_FLAG_NO_RES_RANGE,
69	        ) !== false;
70	    }
71	}

7	
8	class RssParser
9	{
10	    /**
11	     * Parse an RSS 2.0 or Atom feed body into a normalized list of items.
12	     *
13	     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon}>
14	     */
15	    public function parse(string $body): array
16	    {
17	        $previous = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
18	        $xml = simplexml_load_string($body);
19	        libxml_use_internal_errors($previous);
20	
21	        if ($xml === false) {
22	            return [];
23	        }
24	
25	        if (isset($xml->channel)) {
26	            return $this->parseRss($xml);
27	        }
28	
29	        if ($xml->getName() === 'feed') {
30	            return $this->parseAtom($xml);
31	        }
32	
33	        return [];
34	    }
35	
36	    /**
37	     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon}>
38	     */
39	    private function parseRss(SimpleXMLElement $xml): array
40	    {
41	        $items = [];
42	        $media = $xml->channel->children('http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/');
43	
44	        foreach ($xml->channel->item as $item) {
45	            $guid = trim((string) ($item->guid ?: $item->link));
46	            $link = trim((string) $item->link);
47	            $title = trim((string) $item->title);
48	
49	            if ($guid === '' || $link === '' || $title === '') {
50	                continue;
51	            }
52	
53	            $itemMedia = $item->children('http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/');
54	            $imageUrl = null;
55	            if (isset($itemMedia->thumbnail)) {
56	                $imageUrl = (string) $itemMedia->thumbnail->attributes()->url;
57	            } elseif (isset($item->enclosure) && str_starts_with((string) $item->enclosure->attributes()->type, 'image/')) {
58	                $imageUrl = (string) $item->enclosure->attributes()->url;
59	            }
60	
61	            $pubDate = trim((string) $item->pubDate);
62	
63	            $items[] = [
64	                'guid' => $guid,
65	                'title' => $title,
66	                'url' => $link,
67	                'summary' => $this->cleanSummary((string) $item->description) ?: null,
68	                'image_url' => $imageUrl ?: null,
69	                'published_at' => $pubDate !== '' ? $this->parseDate($pubDate) : null,
70	            ];
71	        }
72	
73	        unset($media);
74	
75	        return $items;
76	    }
77	
78	    /**
79	     * @return array<int, array{guid: string, title: string, url: string, summary: ?string, image_url: ?string, published_at: ?Carbon}>
80	     */
81	    private function parseAtom(SimpleXMLElement $xml): array
82	    {
83	        $items = [];
84	
85	        foreach ($xml->entry as $entry) {
86	            $guid = trim((string) $entry->id);
87	            $title = trim((string) $entry->title);
88	
89	            $link = '';
90	            foreach ($entry->link as $linkEl) {
91	                $attrs = $linkEl->attributes();
92	                if ((string) $attrs->rel === '' || (string) $attrs->rel === 'alternate') {
93	                    $link = (string) $attrs->href;
94	                    break;
95	                }
96	            }
97	
98	            if ($guid === '' || $link === '' || $title === '') {
99	                continue;
100	            }
101	
102	            $published = trim((string) ($entry->published ?: $entry->updated));
103	
104	            $items[] = [
105	                'guid' => $guid,
106	                'title' => $title,
107	                'url' => $link,
108	                'summary' => $this->cleanSummary((string) $entry->summary) ?: null,
109	                'image_url' => null,
110	                'published_at' => $published !== '' ? $this->parseDate($published) : null,
111	            ];
112	        }
113	
114	        return $items;
115	    }
116	
117	    private function cleanSummary(string $html): string
118	    {
119	        $text = trim(strip_tags($html));
120	
121	        return mb_strlen($text) > 500 ? mb_substr($text, 0, 497).'...' : $text;
122	    }
123	
124	    private function parseDate(string $value): ?Carbon
125	    {
126	        try {
127	            return Carbon::parse($value);
128	        } catch (\Throwable) {
129	            return null;
130	        }
131	    }
132	}

47	                $this->error("Failed to fetch {$source->name}: HTTP {$response->status()}");

<?php

namespace App\Services\GigLeads;

use App\Support\HostSafety;
use DOMDocument;
use DOMXPath;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use RuntimeException;

class JobDescriptionFetcher
{
    /**
     * Fetch a lead's URL and pull out the job description, preferring the
     * schema.org JobPosting structured data most job boards embed for SEO,
     * falling back to the page's meta description.
     *
     * Returns '' when the page fetched fine but no description was found,
     * distinct from the caller not having attempted a fetch yet.
     */
    public function fetch(string $url): string
    {
        if (! HostSafety::isSafeFeedUrl($url)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('That URL is no longer safe to fetch.');
        }

        $response = Http::timeout(10)
            ->withUserAgent('myeverything-dashboard/1.0')
            ->get($url);

        if (! $response->successful()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Couldn't fetch that page (HTTP {$response->status()}).");
        }

        $html = $response->body();

        return $this->fromJsonLd($html) ?? $this->fromMetaDescription($html) ?? '';
    }

    private function fromJsonLd(string $html): ?string
    {
        if (! preg_match_all('#<script[^>]+type=["\']application/ld\+json["\'][^>]*>(.*?)</script>#is', $html, $matches)) {
            return null;
        }

        foreach ($matches[1] as $block) {
            $data = json_decode(trim($block), true);

            if (! is_array($data)) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach (($data['@graph'] ?? [$data]) as $candidate) {
                if (! is_array($candidate)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $types = (array) ($candidate['@type'] ?? []);

                if (in_array('JobPosting', $types, true) && ! empty($candidate['description'])) {
                    return $this->clean((string) $candidate['description']);
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function fromMetaDescription(string $html): ?string
    {
        $previous = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $dom = new DOMDocument();
        $dom->loadHTML($html, LIBXML_NOERROR | LIBXML_NOWARNING);
        libxml_use_internal_errors($previous);

        $xpath = new DOMXPath($dom);

        foreach (['//meta[@property="og:description"]', '//meta[@name="description"]'] as $query) {
            $node = $xpath->query($query)?->item(0);
            $content = $node?->getAttribute('content');

            if ($content) {
                return $this->clean($content);
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function clean(string $text): string
    {
        $text = preg_replace('#<(br|/p|/div|/li|/h[1-6])\s*/?\s*>#i', "\n", $text) ?? $text;
        $text = strip_tags($text);
        $text = html_entity_decode($text, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5);
        $text = preg_replace('/[ \t]+/', ' ', $text) ?? $text;
        $text = preg_replace('/\n{3,}/', "\n\n", $text) ?? $text;
        $text = trim($text);

        return mb_strlen($text) > 5000 ? mb_substr($text, 0, 4997).'...' : $text;
    }
}

- Handles the three description states distinctly: not yet fetched, fetched-but-empty, and fetched-with-content; shows the server's error message inline on failure

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-20 16:16:15Z)**_

Since `JobPosting` JSON-LD (already wired up for description) typically also carries `title` and `hiringOrganization.name` in the same block, the easiest option is just extending `JobDescriptionFetcher` to pull those two fields alongside description — no new infrastructure, same reliability profile. Fallback options are weaker: parsing `og:title` (usually "Title at Company | Site" — needs fragile string-splitting), per-site CSS-selector scrapers (accurate but breaks on redesigns, and sites like LinkedIn/Indeed serve JS-rendered content that a plain HTTP fetch won't see, pushing you toward a headless browser and more aggressive bot-blocking/ToS exposure), or an LLM call over the fetched text (robust across arbitrary layouts, but adds real cost/latency/complexity for what's a personal dashboard).

My recommendation: extend the JSON-LD path for title/company now, and just leave them blank (or let the user fill them in manually) when JSON-LD isn't present, same as description already does — rather than adding a scraper or LLM call for the fallback case. Want me to build that?

```php
<?php

namespace App\Services\GigLeads;

use App\Support\HostSafety;
use DOMDocument;
use DOMXPath;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use RuntimeException;

class JobPostingFetcher
{
    /**
     * Fetch a lead's URL and pull out the job title, company, and
     * description from the schema.org JobPosting structured data most job
     * boards embed for SEO. Fields fall back to '' (fetched, not found)
     * rather than null (not fetched yet) when the page has no JobPosting
     * block, except description which also falls back to the page's meta
     * description.
     *
     * @return array{title: string, company: string, description: string}
     */
    public function fetch(string $url): array
    {
        if (! HostSafety::isSafeFeedUrl($url)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('That URL is no longer safe to fetch.');
        }

        $response = Http::timeout(10)
            ->withUserAgent('myeverything-dashboard/1.0')
            ->get($url);

        if (! $response->successful()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Couldn't fetch that page (HTTP {$response->status()}).");
        }

        $html = $response->body();
        $jobPosting = $this->fromJsonLd($html);

        return [
            'title' => $jobPosting['title'] ?? '',
            'company' => $jobPosting['company'] ?? '',
            'description' => $jobPosting['description'] ?? $this->fromMetaDescription($html) ?? '',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{title?: string, company?: string, description?: string}|null
     */
    private function fromJsonLd(string $html): ?array
    {
        if (! preg_match_all('#<script[^>]+type=["\']application/ld\+json["\'][^>]*>(.*?)</script>#is', $html, $matches)) {
            return null;
        }

        foreach ($matches[1] as $block) {
            $data = json_decode(trim($block), true);

            if (! is_array($data)) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach (($data['@graph'] ?? [$data]) as $candidate) {
                if (! is_array($candidate)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $types = (array) ($candidate['@type'] ?? []);

                if (! in_array('JobPosting', $types, true)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $organization = $candidate['hiringOrganization'] ?? null;
                $companyName = is_array($organization) ? ($organization['name'] ?? null) : null;

                return [
                    'title' => isset($candidate['title']) ? $this->clean((string) $candidate['title']) : '',
                    'company' => $companyName !== null ? $this->clean((string) $companyName) : '',
                    'description' => ! empty($candidate['description'])
                        ? $this->clean((string) $candidate['description'])
                        : '',
                ];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function fromMetaDescription(string $html): ?string
    {
        $previous = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $dom = new DOMDocument();
        $dom->loadHTML($html, LIBXML_NOERROR | LIBXML_NOWARNING);
        libxml_use_internal_errors($previous);

        $xpath = new DOMXPath($dom);

        foreach (['//meta[@property="og:description"]', '//meta[@name="description"]'] as $query) {
            $node = $xpath->query($query)?->item(0);
            $content = $node?->getAttribute('content');

            if ($content) {
                return $this->clean($content);
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function clean(string $text): string
    {
        $text = preg_replace('#<(br|/p|/div|/li|/h[1-6])\s*/?\s*>#i', "\n", $text) ?? $text;
        $text = strip_tags($text);
        $text = html_entity_decode($text, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5);
        $text = preg_replace('/[ \t]+/', ' ', $text) ?? $text;
        $text = preg_replace('/\n{3,}/', "\n\n", $text) ?? $text;
        $text = trim($text);

        return mb_strlen($text) > 5000 ? mb_substr($text, 0, 4997).'...' : $text;
    }
}

16	export function GigLeadList() {
17	  const [leads, setLeads] = useState<GigLead[]>([]);
18	  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
19	  const [requestId, setRequestId] = useState(0);
20	  const [resolvedId, setResolvedId] = useState(-1);
21	  const loading = requestId !== resolvedId;
22	
23	  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<number | null>(null);
24	  const [fetchingId, setFetchingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
25	  const [descriptionError, setDescriptionError] = useState<string | null>(
26	    null,
27	  );
28	
29	  useEffect(() => {
30	    let ignore = false;
31	
32	    getGigLeads()
33	      .then((data) => {
34	        if (ignore) return;
35	        setLeads(data);
36	        setError(null);
37	      })
38	      .catch(() => {
39	        if (!ignore) setError("Couldn't load your gig leads.");
40	      })
41	      .finally(() => {
42	        if (!ignore) setResolvedId(requestId);
43	      });
44	
45	    return () => {
46	      ignore = true;
47	    };
48	  }, [requestId]);
49	
50	  function reload() {
51	    setRequestId((n) => n + 1);
52	  }
53	
54	  async function handleCreate(input: GigLeadInput) {
55	    await createGigLead(input);
56	    reload();
57	  }
58	
59	  async function handleSetStatus(id: number, status: GigLeadStatus) {
60	    await updateGigLeadStatus(id, status);
61	    reload();
62	  }
63	
64	  async function handleDelete(id: number) {
65	    await deleteGigLead(id);
66	    if (selectedId === id) setSelectedId(null);
67	    reload();
68	  }
69	
70	  async function handleSelect(id: number) {
71	    if (selectedId === id) {
72	      setSelectedId(null);
73	      return;
74	    }
75	
76	    setSelectedId(id);
77	    setDescriptionError(null);
78	
79	    const lead = leads.find((l) => l.id === id);
80	    if (!lead || lead.description !== null) return;
81	
82	    setFetchingId(id);
83	    try {
84	      const updated = await fetchGigLeadDetails(id);
85	      setLeads((prev) => prev.map((l) => (l.id === id ? updated : l)));
86	    } catch (err) {
87	      const message =
88	        err instanceof ApiError &&
89	        typeof err.data === "object" &&
90	        err.data &&
91	        "message" in err.data
92	          ? String((err.data as { message: unknown }).message)
93	          : "Couldn't fetch the job description.";
94	      setDescriptionError(message);
95	    } finally {
96	      setFetchingId(null);
97	    }
98	  }
99	
100	  return (
101	    <div>
102	      <h1 className="mb-4 text-xl font-semibold">Gig Leads</h1>
103	
104	      <div className="mb-4">
105	        <GigLeadForm onSubmit={handleCreate} />
106	      </div>
107	
108	      {error && <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
109	
110	      {loading && leads.length === 0 ? (
111	        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading...</p>
112	      ) : leads.length === 0 ? (
113	        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">No leads yet.</p>
114	      ) : (
115	        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
116	          {leads.map((lead) => (
117	            <GigLeadItem
118	              key={lead.id}
119	              lead={lead}
120	              selected={selectedId === lead.id}
121	              fetchingDescription={fetchingId === lead.id}
122	              descriptionError={selectedId === lead.id ? descriptionError : null}
123	              onSelect={handleSelect}
124	              onSetStatus={handleSetStatus}
125	              onDelete={handleDelete}
126	            />
127	          ))}
128	        </ul>
129	      )}
130	    </div>
131	  );
132	}
133

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-20 16:21:03Z)**_

This all reads correctly and is deployed. Here's what changed:

**Backend**: 
- Migration adds `title` and `company` (nullable `varchar`) alongside the existing `description`
- Renamed `JobDescriptionFetcher` → `JobPostingFetcher` and broadened it to pull `title` and `hiringOrganization.name` from the same `JobPosting` JSON-LD block it was already parsing for `description` — one HTTP fetch, one JSON-LD scan, three fields. Title/company fall back to `''` (fetched, not found) when there's no JSON-LD; description still additionally falls back to meta description.
- Renamed the endpoint `fetch-description` → `fetch-details` and its controller method to match the broadened scope; it now saves all three fields in one `update()` call.

**Frontend**:
- Collapsed list rows now show the parsed **title** as the heading (falling back to the URL when not yet fetched or not found), with **company** folded into the metadata line and the raw URL shown as a small muted line underneath once a title exists
- The expanded panel shows title + company above the description
- Renamed the description-scoped state/props (`fetchingDescription`/`descriptionError` → `fetchingDetails`/`detailsError`) since they now gate all three fields together

Verified via `tinker`: full JSON-LD (title + `hiringOrganization` + description) extracts all three correctly, and a `JobPosting` missing `hiringOrganization` degrades company to `''` without breaking. Typecheck is clean, production build succeeded, and `myeverything-web` was rebuilt and restarted.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-20 17:36:24Z)**_

That's expected, not a bug in the code — both of your saved leads are Indeed URLs, and Indeed returns HTTP 403 to any non-browser request (the same block I hit testing this earlier). I deliberately didn't spoof a browser user-agent to get around that, since that crosses into evading a site's anti-scraping protections. On top of that, both URLs are actually Indeed *search-results* pages (`/jobs?q=php&l=remote...`), not individual job-posting pages — so even without the block, there's likely no `JobPosting` JSON-LD there to find.

Two things worth fixing regardless: right now a failed fetch isn't cached, so every click re-hits Indeed and shows the same error again — I'd persist a "tried, failed" state so it doesn't hammer the site pointlessly. And since Indeed will probably never work here, a manual override to type in title/company/description yourself would make failed leads usable. Want me to build both?

12	class GigLeadController extends Controller
13	{
14	    public function index(Request $request)
15	    {
16	        $leads = $request->user()->gigLeads()->latest()->get();
17	
18	        return GigLeadResource::collection($leads);
19	    }
20	
21	    public function store(Request $request)
22	    {
23	        $validated = $request->validate([
24	            'url' => [
25	                'required',
26	                'url:http,https',
27	                'max:2048',
28	                Rule::unique('gig_leads')->where('user_id', $request->user()->id),
29	            ],
30	            'country' => ['required', Rule::in(['usa', 'canada'])],
31	            'job_type' => ['required', Rule::in([
32	                'full_time',
33	                'part_time',
34	                'short_term_contract',
35	                'long_term_contract',
36	            ])],
37	            'origin' => ['required', Rule::in(['linkedin', 'arc', 'indeed', 'gunio', 'other'])],
38	        ]);
39	
40	        $lead = $request->user()->gigLeads()->create([
41	            ...$validated,
42	            'status' => 'new',
43	        ]);
44	
45	        return new GigLeadResource($lead);
46	    }
47	
48	    public function update(Request $request, GigLead $gigLead)
49	    {
50	        $this->authorize('update', $gigLead);
51	
52	        $validated = $request->validate([
53	            'status' => ['required', Rule::in(['new', 'reviewed', 'dismissed'])],
54	        ]);
55	
56	        $gigLead->update($validated);
57	
58	        return new GigLeadResource($gigLead);
59	    }
60	
61	    public function fetchDetails(Request $request, GigLead $gigLead, JobPostingFetcher $fetcher)
62	    {
63	        $this->authorize('update', $gigLead);
64	
65	        if ($gigLead->description !== null) {
66	            return new GigLeadResource($gigLead);
67	        }
68	
69	        try {
70	            $gigLead->update($fetcher->fetch($gigLead->url));
71	        } catch (Throwable $e) {
72	            return response()->json(['message' => $e->getMessage()], 502);
73	        }
74	
75	        return new GigLeadResource($gigLead);
76	    }
77	
78	    public function destroy(Request $request, GigLead $gigLead)
79	    {
80	        $this->authorize('delete', $gigLead);
81	
82	        $gigLead->delete();
83	
84	        return response()->noContent();
85	    }
86	}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import type {
  GigLead,
  GigLeadDetailsInput,
  GigLeadJobType,
  GigLeadOrigin,
  GigLeadStatus,
} from "@/lib/gig-lead-types";

const JOB_TYPE_LABELS: Record<GigLeadJobType, string> = {
  full_time: "Full time",
  part_time: "Part time",
  short_term_contract: "Short term contract",
  long_term_contract: "Long term contract",
};

const ORIGIN_LABELS: Record<GigLeadOrigin, string> = {
  linkedin: "LinkedIn",
  arc: "Arc",
  indeed: "Indeed",
  gunio: "Gun.io",
  other: "Other",
};

export function GigLeadItem({
  lead,
  selected,
  fetchingDetails,
  detailsError,
  onSelect,
  onSetStatus,
  onDelete,
  onSaveDetails,
}: {
  lead: GigLead;
  selected: boolean;
  fetchingDetails: boolean;
  detailsError: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: number) => void;
  onSetStatus: (id: number, status: GigLeadStatus) => void;
  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
  onSaveDetails: (id: number, input: GigLeadDetailsInput) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const addedAt = new Date(lead.added_at).toLocaleString();
  const heading = lead.title || lead.url;
  const subline = [
    lead.company,
    lead.country === "usa" ? "USA" : "Canada",
    JOB_TYPE_LABELS[lead.job_type],
    ORIGIN_LABELS[lead.origin],
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" · ");

  const [formTitle, setFormTitle] = useState(lead.title ?? "");
  const [formCompany, setFormCompany] = useState(lead.company ?? "");
  const [formDescription, setFormDescription] = useState(
    lead.description ?? "",
  );
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selected) {
      setFormTitle(lead.title ?? "");
      setFormCompany(lead.company ?? "");
      setFormDescription(lead.description ?? "");
      setSaveError(null);
    }
    // Re-sync once a fetch resolves (lead.description flips from null),
    // but not on every unrelated re-render while the panel stays open.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [selected, lead.description]);

  async function handleSave(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveError(null);
    try {
      await onSaveDetails(lead.id, {
        title: formTitle.trim(),
        company: formCompany.trim(),
        description: formDescription.trim(),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const message =
        err instanceof ApiError &&
        typeof err.data === "object" &&
        err.data &&
        "message" in err.data
          ? String((err.data as { message: unknown }).message)
          : "Couldn't save those details.";
      setSaveError(message);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <li
      className={`rounded border border-black/10 p-3 text-sm dark:border-white/10 ${
        lead.status === "dismissed" ? "opacity-50" : ""
      }`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onSelect(lead.id)}
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left"
          aria-expanded={selected}
        >
          <p className="truncate font-medium hover:underline">{heading}</p>
          <p className="truncate text-xs text-zinc-500">{subline}</p>
          {lead.title && (
            <p className="truncate text-xs text-zinc-400">{lead.url}</p>
          )}
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Added {addedAt}</p>
        </button>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onSelect(lead.id)}
            className="hover:text-foreground"
          >
            Edit details
          </button>
          {lead.status !== "reviewed" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSetStatus(lead.id, "reviewed")}
              className="hover:text-foreground"
            >
              Mark reviewed
            </button>
          )}
          {lead.status !== "dismissed" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSetStatus(lead.id, "dismissed")}
              className="hover:text-foreground"
            >
              Dismiss
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onDelete(lead.id)}
            className="hover:text-red-600"
          >
            Delete
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {selected && (
        <div className="mt-3 border-t border-black/10 pt-3 dark:border-white/10">
          <a
            href={lead.url}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noreferrer noopener"
            className="mb-2 inline-block text-xs font-medium hover:underline"
          >
            Open listing ↗
          </a>

          {fetchingDetails ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Fetching job details...</p>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              {detailsError && (
                <p className="text-xs text-red-600">
                  Couldn&apos;t auto-fetch details: {detailsError}. Enter them
                  manually below.
                </p>
              )}

              <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                Job title
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormTitle(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Not parsed — enter manually"
                  className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 text-sm text-foreground dark:border-white/10"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                Company
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formCompany}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormCompany(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Not parsed — enter manually"
                  className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 text-sm text-foreground dark:border-white/10"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                Description
                <textarea
                  value={formDescription}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormDescription(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Not parsed — enter manually"
                  rows={5}
                  className="rounded border border-black/10 px-2 py-1 text-sm text-foreground dark:border-white/10"
                />
              </label>

              {saveError && <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{saveError}</p>}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={saving}
                className="self-start rounded bg-foreground px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-background disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save details"}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-20 17:43:04Z)**_

Deployed. Summary of what changed:

**Backend**: `GigLeadController::update` now accepts optional `title`, `company`, and `description` (each `sometimes|nullable|string`) alongside the existing `status`, so a single PATCH can save manually-entered or corrected fields without disturbing the others. Verified both the manual-save path and the existing status-toggle path work independently.

**Frontend**:
- Added an explicit **"Edit details"** button next to Mark reviewed/Dismiss/Delete on each lead — it opens the same expand panel as clicking the row (still lazily triggers the parse fetch if not yet attempted)
- The panel is now an editable form (title, company, description) instead of read-only text. It's pre-filled from whatever the parser found; where a field is empty, the input just shows an "enter manually" placeholder instead of a value
- If auto-fetch failed (e.g. Indeed's 403), the error shows above the form as a note, but the form still renders underneath so you can fill everything in by hand
- Saving PATCHes only those three fields and updates the row in place

One side effect worth knowing: since a manual save always writes a non-null `description`, saving once — even with blank fields — stops the app from re-attempting the auto-fetch against that URL on future opens (it only auto-fetches when `description` is still `null`). So filling in your two Indeed leads by hand will also make the panel stop retrying against Indeed.
